comment: Source read at commit f6cf8d6, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The IN inputs and OUT outputs get no family: the maker's own manual has them carrying audio, control voltage, gates or a constant, depending on the patch. The rate parameter is configured as 2 to the power of the value in Hertz, -5 to 13.5 (DualIntegrator.cpp:74), and the result is multiplied by 20 in process() to match a 20V peak-to-peak swing, so the figures at the knob are the cycling frequency rather than volts per second. The mode switch is configured with the choices Track and Hold at 0 and Sample and Hold at 1, and the maker's panel standard puts a switch ON when it is upright.
